threat_event: Unauthorized control of spillway gates or turbine units through construction or vendor connections that bypass Hydro OT access controls
threat_source: Cybercriminal or nation-state actor using a compromised contractor device
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Constructors commissioning kits (cellular router plus laptop) connected to plant and gate control networks; treated as internal because Constructors is an affiliate; no EDR on kits
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-H2; SYS-H3; SYS-C3 at 7 Hydro rehabilitation sites
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3a access control; Form 3 Q12); C-DAMS-R03 (CIP-003-9 Att. 1 Sec. 5 and 6); C-DAMS-R02 (12.3(b)(4)(ii), (xi))
existing_controls: Intermediate Systems with MFA for vendor access; interim rule from 2026-07-16 (escorted, scheduled sessions only)
treatment_plan: Group standard for commissioning at Hydro sites: Hydro-managed or reviewed transient devices, no cellular routers, remote help only through Intermediate Systems; EDR on all kits; treat affiliates as vendors in every OT control

threat_event: Ransomware spreads through shared IT and halts the DSMS, the FPE, project platforms, and corporate services in several divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared identity, network, and cloud platform connect all divisions; about 410 jobsite trailers and 140 unmanaged commissioning laptops
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G1; SYS-G3; SYS-G5; SYS-E1; SYS-C1; SYS-C2
regulatory_driver: SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05; N23-R03 (252.204-7012(c)); C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3a restoration)
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR on managed endpoints; immutable backups; PAM
treatment_plan: EDR on all kits and jobsite devices; segment jobsite trailers; quarterly restore tests of the DSMS and FPE; cross-division tabletop (P08)

threat_event: An attacker who compromises the DSMS uses the two-way historian replication to reach Hydro OT DMZs
threat_source: Nation-state or criminal actor targeting the cloud service
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two-way replication at 17 HOC-operated plants instead of one-way diodes; no intercompany interconnection agreement
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-E1; SYS-H5 OT DMZs at 17 plants
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3a segregation; network connections); C-DAMS-R03 (CIP-003-9 Att. 1 Sec. 3.1)
existing_controls: Plant gateway firewalls allow only historian ports; SOC monitoring of the DSMS
treatment_plan: Replace two-way replication with one-way transfer at 17 plants; intercompany interconnection agreement; DSMS penetration test

threat_event: A cross-division incident misses one or more regulatory reporting clocks (CIP-008 1 hour, DFARS 72 hours, 18 CFR 12.10, Form 8-K 4 business days)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single notification matrix never exercised; reporting duties split across divisions and counsel
existing_controls: Division reporting procedures; General Counsel owns the matrix
treatment_plan: Complete and exercise the multi-regulator matrix (P08); cross-division tabletop 2026-11-17; out-of-band contact list; DoD medium assurance certificate held by 2 people

threat_event: Dam safety anomalies are missed because AI-001 alerts replaced manual review and the model changes without control
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 31 Hydro dams moved to monthly manual readings relying on AI-001; thresholds and model versions change without change records; 19 external clients in the pilot
existing_controls: Rules-based thresholds still run; dam safety engineers review alerts
treatment_plan: Return the 31 dams to weekly manual readings until AI-001 meets its conditions; formal change control for thresholds and models; quarterly back-tests (P10)

threat_event: CUI is disclosed or mishandled, and Constructors loses or cannot obtain the CMMC status needed for USACE awards
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Level 2 self-assessment score of 74 of 110; CUI in SYS-C1 and productivity shares; CMMC Phase 2 suspended but SP 800-171 Rev. 2 still owed under DFARS 252.204-7012
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-C2; SYS-C1; SYS-G6; 11 USACE and 14 A-E contracts
existing_controls: FPE in a government-community region; DLP since 2026-06
treatment_plan: Purge CUI from SYS-C1 and shares; close POA&M items to reach at least 88 with only eligible items open; C3PAO assessment 2027-03-15

threat_event: Common controls assumed by Constructors and Engineering systems are not operating as expected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inheritance documented for Hydro only; division owners unsure which controls they own
regulatory_driver: N23-R04 (SP 800-171 R2 3.12.4 for the FPE); C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3a roles)
existing_controls: Common control catalog (P02); FPE SSP
treatment_plan: Inheritance matrices for Constructors and Engineering; annual confirmation by division leads

threat_event: A compromise or failure at the governor and excitation OEM affects 55% of Hydro units at once
threat_source: Supply chain attacker or vendor outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One OEM services 55% of units through remote support; 2025 renewal skipped CIP-013 terms
existing_controls: OEM access only through Intermediate Systems with recording; tier 1 vendor reviews
treatment_plan: Amend the OEM contract with CIP-013 terms; second qualified service vendor for governors; offline copies of every governor configuration

threat_event: An insider with OT access misuses gate or unit controls
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broad operator privileges are needed for operations; separation between operators and engineers exists
existing_controls: Personnel risk assessments every 7 years; command logging; two-person rule for logic changes
treatment_plan: Command anomaly alerts in the SOC; insider threat scenarios in the 2027 exercise

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects progress payments or vendor payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 5,200 subcontractors and suppliers; payment changes requested by email
existing_controls: Call-back verification of banking changes; email authentication
treatment_plan: Payment change portal with MFA; annual payment fraud training for project accountants

threat_event: The disclosure committee decides materiality late or wrongly for an OT or dam safety incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Committee has never exercised an OT scenario; materiality factors for safety events not written down
regulatory_driver: SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05; Reg S-K Item 106
existing_controls: Committee charter covers cybersecurity incidents
treatment_plan: OT and dam safety materiality factors in the charter; tabletop 2026-11-17

threat_event: Division supplements drift from group policy, so controls are not applied where divisions meet
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Constructors supplement last aligned 2023; it treats Hydro plants as ordinary jobsites
existing_controls: Group policy says group policy governs
treatment_plan: Re-issue the Constructors supplement with a Hydro site section; annual attestation

threat_event: A SaaS or engineering vendor breach exposes client CEII, BCSI, or project data from several divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 610 vendors with system or data access; CEII also in general shares
existing_controls: Tiered third-party program; annual reviews of tier 1 vendors
treatment_plan: CEII and BCSI only in restricted libraries; vendor terms for CEII

threat_event: A cloud provider-wide outage stops the DSMS, the FPE, and the scheduling platform together
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DSMS and scheduling on provider A; FPE on provider B; no cross-provider failover
existing_controls: Warm standby regions within each provider
treatment_plan: Document provider outage playbooks; clients fall back to local alarms

threat_event: A physical attack on a Group 1 dam is combined with a cyber disruption of the HOC
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Group 1 dams are high-consequence; coordinated attacks are planned for in the Vulnerability Assessments
existing_controls: Vulnerability Assessments; Security Plans with threat-level procedures; guards at Group 1 dams
treatment_plan: Joint physical and cyber scenario in the 2027 Security Plan exercise

threat_event: The payroll provider fails and weekly craft payroll is late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One payroll provider for 45,000 employees
existing_controls: Repeat-prior-payroll procedure; provider SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low by the Group Chief Risk Officer: the repeat-payroll procedure was tested in 2025

threat_event: Staff enter CEII, BCSI, or CUI into unapproved generative AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 45,000 users; enterprise AI assistant approved only for some roles
existing_controls: Approved-tools list; web filtering of public AI tools on managed devices
treatment_plan: DLP rules for CEII, BCSI, and CUI markings in the enterprise assistant; training

threat_event: A destructive attack on the group identity platform halts all IT in every division
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One identity platform for 51,000 identities; break-glass accounts per critical system
existing_controls: Vendor multi-region service; break-glass accounts tested quarterly; OT does not trust SYS-G1
treatment_plan: Daily configuration export restore test; out-of-band administration path

threat_event: Regulatory changes across divisions are missed (CMMC Phase 2 suspension, proposed FAR Part 40, CIP-015, CIRCIA final rule)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Each division tracks its own regulators
existing_controls: Quarterly regulatory change review by the Chief Compliance Officer
treatment_plan: One group regulatory calendar shared by all divisions

threat_event: Personal information of employees and craft workers is stolen, triggering notices in many states
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 45,000 employees and about 6,000 subcontractor workers in HR, payroll, and badging records across 23 states
regulatory_driver: State breach laws (Florida worked example: Fla. Stat. 501.171)
existing_controls: Encryption; access controls in HR systems
treatment_plan: Remove badging lists with driver's license numbers from SYS-C1; data minimization
